desc: Want low recoil with optimum performance? NobelSport's Target Low Recoil loads are the answer. Loaded with proprietary powder to burn clean and produce maximum velocity with the least possible recoil, NobelSport supplies a new generation of soft shooting, hard hitting target loads. Available in a variety of shot sizes for skeet, trap and sporting clays. At 1200 fps, Target Low Recoil loads are a perfect velocity match for other NobelSport Target Skeet loads. Hard shot, NobelSport wads, primers and high quality casings are the final guarantee of competition quality. If low recoil and high performance payload fit into your target shooting plans, Target Low Recoil loads are your answer.
